title: Chill Drive Together
description: Long long time ago in an unknown place, the legend and mythology were together in there. We will invite you to go to the journey with SonOGong – the Monkey King.Ten members help you to overcome all troubles in the adventure. And you can use 10 Taoist magic by the one scroll.You can get various items in the journey. All of them give you more power. You will also get the more power to fight if you defeat enemies.In trouble, you should use the secret power of SonOGong… That power makes enemies in fearWe hope you will achieve the goal through defeating seven boss monsters and a lot of their soldiers that disturb your party’s journey.[Game Mode]Normal Mode : Destroy the temple that is an enemy base.Rescue Mode : Protect the Samzang Monks in order to save village people were captured.Sky Mode : Ride your GeunDuWoon(Cloud) and Fight your enemies in the SkyBoss Mode : The powerful boss disturb you to go forward. You should defeat him if you want to go forward.105 stages, more powerful enemies, variety magics and summon, Aura depends on the weapon, and hot blood modeHot blood SonOGong gives you new experience you have never had before.!!!!Game and other inquiriesteamrefly@gamil.com
